correctness.rationale: A tensor-factor projection compression of quasidiagonal approximations preserves quasidiagonality, forcing uniform word-sector masses in tensor powers. The sector projection gives the lower norm-distance bound, while the quasidiagonal product trace attains it. Restrictions to finite stages then force distance 2 in the spatial infinite tensor power.

value.rationale: The result quantifies how severe the newly discovered failure of faciality can be: finite RFD tensor powers give exact distances 2(1-2^-r), approaching the state-space diameter, and the infinite tensor power reaches the maximal distance 2 while the separated trace remains amenable.
